caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object set against a plain, light-colored background. The object is conical in shape, wider at the base and narrowing towards the top into a short cylindrical spout. The body of the object is a dark brownish-gray color, with visible dents, scratches, and areas of discoloration, suggesting it is made of a tarnished or rusted metal. Attached to the sides are two curved metal handles, one on each side, each of which extends away from the body with an irregular, looping form. One of the handles, on the left, further extends upward in a wavy, elongated fashion, while the other, on the right, is shorter and curves outward from the body. The base of the object is a slightly darker rim that defines the edge and provides stability to the form. The background is simple, with no additional objects or details, allowing focus on the central metallic object.
title: Torch
